title: A2: inward JMAP Chat: a ChatBackend over crate-jmap's MemoryBackend, wired to the engine
description: Wrap crate-jmap-chat-server's memory::MemoryBackend (feature memory, v0.5.0): delegate storage and queries; hooks turn client writes into MIMI operations: Chat/set create (group) -> host a room (Room/create) or join; Chat/set addMembers -> invite (KeyMaterial/fetch + Room/update); Message/set create -> encode mimi-content, encrypt, Room/send (senderMsgId per R1); Chat/set removeMembers / destroy -> leave (protocol-07 §3.5, F5: send the MLS removal before the server's Follower::leave). Inbound: each decrypted application message inserted as a Message (mapping per draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00: message IDs, senders, edits, topics, reactions); participants from the participant list. Unsupported JMAP features answer per the spec (e.g. unknownMethod / forbidden).
